en.config.apiKey.tooltip: Bearer token for the image service (Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>)
en.action.generate.label: AI Text to Image
en.action.generate.description: Generate images from text descriptions via an OpenAI-compatible async image API.
en.action.edit.label: AI Image Edit
en.action.edit.description: Edit images from reference image(s) and a text instruction (multi-image fusion / inpainting / mask editing; gpt-image-1, flux-kontext, etc.).
en.action.query.label: Query Image Task
en.action.query.description: Query an async image task by task_id once. Returns current status and images if finished.
en.field.apiKey.label: API Key
en.field.apiKey.tooltip: Bearer token for the image service.
en.field.baseUrl.label: API Base URL
en.field.prompt.label: Image Description

en.field.editPrompt.label: Edit Instruction
en.field.editPrompt.tooltip: Describe how to edit the image, e.g. "put on sunglasses", "watercolor style".
en.field.model.label: Model
en.field.aspectRatio.label: Aspect Ratio
en.field.n.label: Count
en.field.image.label: Reference Image
en.field.image.tooltip: Image URL / data URI / local path. Multiple allowed. JSON array supported.
en.field.mask.label: Mask (optional)
en.field.mask.tooltip: PNG mask: transparent (alpha=0) areas are edited. Same size as the first image. gpt-image-1 only.
en.field.taskId.label: Task ID
en.field.taskId.tooltip: task_id returned by a generate/edit action.
